cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.12)
project(tb4_marco_bridge)
find_package(ament_cmake REQUIRED)
find_package(ament_cmake_python REQUIRED)
ament_python_install_package(${PROJECT_NAME})
install(PROGRAMS scripts/marco DESTINATION lib/${PROJECT_NAME})
# Read upstream source only. Every generated file stays in the colcon build/install dirs.
set(TB4_MARCO_ROOT "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/../../MARCO" CACHE PATH "Unmodified MARCO checkout")
find_package(Python3 COMPONENTS Interpreter Development QUIET)
if(Python3_FOUND AND EXISTS "${TB4_MARCO_ROOT}/native/grid_geometry/geometry.cpp")
  ament_get_python_install_dir(PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR)
  Python3_add_library(_grid_geometry_native MODULE "${TB4_MARCO_ROOT}/native/grid_geometry/geometry.cpp")
  target_compile_features(_grid_geometry_native PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
  target_compile_options(_grid_geometry_native PRIVATE -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
  install(TARGETS _grid_geometry_native LIBRARY DESTINATION "${PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR}")
  find_package(pybind11 CONFIG QUIET)
  if(pybind11_FOUND)
    pybind11_add_module(_chain_bnb_native NO_EXTRAS "${TB4_MARCO_ROOT}/native/chain_bnb/chain_bnb.cpp")
    target_compile_features(_chain_bnb_native PRIVATE cxx_std_17)
    target_compile_options(_chain_bnb_native PRIVATE -O3 -fno-fast-math -ffp-contract=off)
    install(TARGETS _chain_bnb_native LIBRARY DESTINATION "${PYTHON_INSTALL_DIR}")
  endif()
endif()
ament_package()
